name: io.github.kolivritech/memoria-mcp
title: Memoria — Deterministic AI Memory & Code Intelligence MCP
description: Official Node.js MCP connector for Memoria Cloud (https://memoria.kolivri.com).

tools.name: encode_memory
tools.description: Store a single memory record in Memoreal Cloud (consumes 1 Write API call; non-idempotent: encoding identical text twice creates separate IDs until consolidate is run) and return { id, namespace, salience }. Defaults type to "episodic", salience to 0.5 (items >=0.7 or semantic/core surface in memory://rules), and namespace to "default" while rejecting reserved "org:" prefixes. Use when persisting one architectural decision, bug root cause, or user rule; use batch_encode instead for 2+ memories at once, or handoff_to_agent for cross-wing task handoffs.

namespace.description: Logical project or workspace namespace (defaults to "default"; never prefix with "org:").

type.description: Memory tier classification (core and semantic receive 1.5x/1.25x recall boosts).

salience.description: Importance weight from 0.0 to 1.0 (use >=0.7 for durable team rules).

context.description: Optional [key, value] string pairs (for example [["file", "src/auth.js"]]) targetable by delete_by_context.

tools.name: batch_encode
tools.description: Store multiple memories atomically in one request (consumes max(1, memories.length) Write API calls; non-idempotent) and return { ids, encoded }. Validates every item namespace before writing so any reserved "org:" prefix aborts the entire batch cleanly; items inherit top-level namespace and default to type="episodic" and salience=0.5. Use when checkpointing or importing 2+ memories together; use encode_memory instead for a single memory write.

namespace.description: Fallback logical workspace namespace applied to batch items that omit namespace.

memories.description: Non-empty array of memory objects ({ content, type?, salience?, namespace?, context? }).

namespace.description: Optional per-item logical namespace override (never prefix with "org:").

tools.name: recall_memories
tools.description: Retrieve up to 20 deterministically ranked memory records for a query (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } with per-item { memory, score }. Scores up to 500 candidates in namespace by lexical match (0.55), salience (0.30), and 30-day freshness (0.15) multiplied by tier boost (core=1.5x, semantic=1.25x), excluding items below min_salience. Use when you need individual memory IDs, metadata, or scores (for inspection, feedback, or forget_memory); use build_context instead for a ready-to-inject <memory_context> block, or search_code for code symbols.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to search (defaults to "default"; never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Keywords or natural-language topic to match against stored memory content.

token_budget.description: Advisory token budget hint for downstream context sizing (default 4096).

min_salience.description: Minimum salience filter (0.0-1.0); memories strictly below this value are excluded.

tools.name: build_context
tools.description: Assemble a token-budgeted <memory_context> XML/Markdown block from a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { context, memories_used }. Ranks up to 500 namespace memories deterministically and packs lines greedily up to max(256, token_budget * 4) characters under "## Established Facts" (core/semantic) and "## Recent Context" (episodic/buffer). Use at session start or before planning a task to ground the model in one call; use recall_memories instead when you need raw memory objects and IDs.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to ground context around (never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Active task, feature, or session topic used to rank relevant facts and history.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget (~4 characters per token, default 4096) before truncating lower-ranked items.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete one memory and its incident graph edges by ID (destructive, idempotent; consumes 1 Write API call) and return { deleted }. Enforces organization ownership (returns JSON-RPC error -32003 on foreign IDs) and returns { deleted: false } when the ID is already absent. Use when removing a single known memory ID; use delete_by_context instead to bulk-delete memories by [key, value] metadata tag, or feedback (useful=false) to lower salience without deleting.

id.description: Exact memory UUID returned by encode_memory or recall_memories.

tools.name: delete_by_context
tools.description: Permanently bulk-delete all memories whose context array contains an exact [key, value] pair (destructive, idempotent; consumes 1 Write API call) and return { deleted_count }. Scopes deletion to namespace when provided, or across all namespaces in your organization when namespace is omitted (rejecting reserved "org:" prefixes). Use to purge memories tied to a deleted file, PR, or feature tag; use forget_memory instead when deleting a single memory by UUID.

namespace.description: Optional logical namespace filter; omit to match across the entire organization.

key.description: Exact context tuple key to match (for example "file" or "pr").

value.description: Exact context tuple value to match (for example "src/legacy.js").

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Adjust a memory salience weight based on recall utility (consumes 1 Write API call; non-idempotent because repeated calls compound the salience delta) and return { updated }. Enforces organization ownership on id; useful=true boosts salience toward 1.0 while useful=false dampens noisy or outdated entries without deleting them. Use after recall_memories to tune future ranking quality; use forget_memory instead for permanent removal, or consolidate to merge duplicate records.

useful.description: True to boost salience when helpful; false to dampen salience when stale or noisy.

tools.name: consolidate
tools.description: Run an idempotent maintenance pass on a workspace namespace to deduplicate redundant records, link superseded state, and promote recurring high-salience episodic memories to Semantic tier (consumes 1 Write API call; non-destructive to unique facts) and return { namespace, consolidated }. Requires Write permission and a valid logical namespace (never prefixed with "org:"). Use at session wrap-up after multiple encode_memory calls; use feedback instead to rate one memory, or delete_by_context to purge obsolete tags.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to consolidate (for example "my-project").

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check Memoreal Cloud service status, total organization memory count across all namespaces, and rolling 30-day API quota usage (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call on tools/call) and return { status, memory_count, used_calls_30d, api_call_limit }. Takes no parameters; api_call_limit is null on Unlimited plans. Use to verify connectivity and overall organization quota headroom; use stats instead when you need memory counts scoped to one specific project namespace.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Retrieve the stored memory count for a single logical namespace alongside rolling 30-day organization quota metrics (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { namespace, memory_count, used_calls_30d, api_call_limit }. Rejects reserved "org:" prefixes on namespace. Use when inspecting how many memories exist inside one specific project or wing namespace; use health instead for an organization-wide connectivity and total-memory check, or list_agent_wings for per-wing counts.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to inspect (for example "my-project" or "wing:qa").

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search indexed code symbol definitions, file paths, and reference memories within a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } capped at 20 ranked { memory, score } hits. Requires code memories in namespace (populated via /memoreal-sync-code or encode_memory) and rejects reserved "org:" prefixes. Use to discover where functions, classes, or routes live by keyword; use explain_code instead to inspect callers and invariants of a known symbol, or recall_memories for general prose rules.

namespace.description: Logical repository or workspace namespace to search (never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Function, class, route, or file keyword to locate.

tools.name: explain_code
tools.description: Synthesize definitions, caller/callee references, related tests, and architectural notes for a specific code symbol in a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } (up to 20 ranked matches). Pass the identifier via symbol or its equivalent alias target (if both are supplied, symbol takes precedence). Use before editing a known function, class, or module to check its blast radius and invariants; use search_code instead when you only have keywords and need to find symbol names first.

namespace.description: Logical repository or workspace namespace containing indexed code memories.

symbol.description: Exact function, class, or module name to explain (preferred; equivalent to target).

target.description: Alias for symbol accepted for client compatibility when symbol is omitted.

tools.name: list_agent_wings
tools.description: List all five built-in specialist multi-agent wings (architect, reviewer, qa, security, ops), their isolated wing:<id> namespaces, and active memory counts (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { wings }. Always returns all five wings even when memory_count is 0. Use to inspect wing responsibilities and queued handoff volume before delegating work; use handoff_to_agent to record a new cross-wing handoff, or stats to inspect a custom project namespace.

namespace.description: Optional logical workspace namespace context (never prefix with "org:").

tools.name: handoff_to_agent
tools.description: Persist a high-salience (0.9) Semantic handoff memory into a target specialist wing namespace (wing:<target>) (consumes 1 Write API call; non-idempotent: repeated calls create distinct handoff records) and return { id, wing, namespace }. Accepts target wing via wing or alias to_wing (defaults to "architect") and sender via from_agent or alias from_wing (defaults to "agent"), attaching files and memory_ids as searchable context tuples. Use when delegating findings and next steps between architect, reviewer, qa, security, or ops agents; use encode_memory instead for general project memories.

wing.description: Destination specialist wing (preferred; defaults to "architect" if both wing and to_wing are omitted).

to_wing.description: Alias for destination wing used when wing is omitted.

from_agent.description: Identifier of the sending agent or role (preferred; defaults to "agent").

from_wing.description: Alias for sending specialist wing used when from_agent is omitted.

summary.description: Required concise summary of architectural findings, constraints, and state.

task.description: Optional concrete follow-up action appended for the receiving wing.

files.description: Optional file paths attached as ["file", path] context tags.

memory_ids.description: Optional related memory UUIDs attached as ["memory_id", id] context tags.
